يلتبسا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَبِسَا (yaltabisā) /jal.ta.bi.saː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# يُلْتَبَسَا (yultabasā) /jul.ta.ba.saː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
